en_title: Tekken Legend Katsuhiro Harada Says He Wishes 'Hardware Like the Xbox Series S Wouldn't Be Released'
cn_title: 《铁拳》传奇人物原田胜弘表示，希望「XBOX Series S这样的硬件不要再推出」
opus_summary: 《铁拳》开发者原田胜弘批评XBOX Series S性能偏低，称希望不要推出类似硬件。《赛博朋克2077》副游戏总监Paweł Sasko认可其缺点，同时指出较低售价和优化成果带来的好处。

paragraphs.en: Tekken development legend Katsuhiro Harada had some strong comments for Microsoft's lower-powered Xbox Series S console, dubbing it a "weaker child" with "awkwardly lower performance."
paragraphs.cn: 《铁拳》开发界传奇人物原田胜弘对微软性能较弱的XBOX Series S主机发表了一番措辞强烈的评论，称其为「性能低得很尴尬」的「较弱的孩子」。

paragraphs.en: A number of video game developers have struggled with the Xbox Series S while following Microsoft's feature parity rules across Xbox Series consoles. Baldur's Gate 3 famously came to Xbox a few months late and required the help of Microsoft's engineers to get the game's split-screen co-op working on Series S . More recently, the developer of breakout shooter Wardogs admitted that the limitations of the Xbox Series S had stopped it from adding certain things to the game .
paragraphs.cn: 不少电子游戏开发者在遵守微软针对XBOX Series各款主机的功能对等规定时，都曾为XBOX Series S感到头疼。众所周知，《博德之门3》比原定时间晚了几个月才登陆XBOX，而且需要微软工程师的帮助，才让游戏的分屏合作功能在Series S上运行起来。最近，爆款射击游戏《战狗》的开发商承认，XBOX Series S的局限性使其无法在游戏中加入某些内容。

paragraphs.en: Indeed, one of the questions facing Microsoft ever since the release of the Xbox Series S back in 2020 is whether it would be willing to allow developers and publishers to release a game on Xbox Series X only, leaving Xbox Series S behind. As it stands, Xbox mandates that video games launch on both or none at all, and that there should be main feature parity between each version.
paragraphs.cn: 事实上，自XBOX Series S于2020年推出以来，微软面临的问题之一便是，是否愿意允许开发商和发行商只在XBOX Series X上发行游戏，而不考虑XBOX Series S。按照目前的规定，XBOX要求电子游戏要么同时在两款主机上推出，要么都不推出，且各版本的主要功能应当保持一致。

paragraphs.en: In a roundtable discussion held at the Console Game Developers Conference in Korea, Harada slammed the Series S and attempted to encourage Cyberpunk 2077 associate game director Paweł Sasko to join in the pile-on, too.
paragraphs.cn: 在韩国举行的Console Game Developers Conference圆桌讨论中，原田猛烈批评了Series S，还试图鼓励《赛博朋克2077》副游戏总监Paweł Sasko也加入批评的行列。

paragraphs.en: "There's something I really want to say while I have the floor," Harada began (thanks, Inven Global ), "since a senior Xbox official is actually in attendance here today, I wish hardware like the Xbox Series S wouldn't be released (laughs)."
paragraphs.cn: 「趁着我在发言，有件事我真的很想说，」原田开口道（感谢Inven Global），「既然今天现场正好有一位XBOX高管在场，我希望XBOX Series S这样的硬件不要再推出（笑）。」

paragraphs.en: Throughout his years in charge of Tekken, Harada has become known as a colorful character happy to express his opinions freely. And, to be fair, it sounds like Harada made the comment knowing he was being rather cheeky. But the developer then continued to explain his position further — and have Sasko back him up, following reports that CD Projekt struggled with Cyberpunk 2077's Series S version.
paragraphs.cn: 在负责《铁拳》的这些年里，原田以个性鲜明、乐于自由表达意见而闻名。公平地说，听起来原田发表这番言论时，知道自己相当大胆。不过，在有报道称CD Projekt在开发《赛博朋克2077》的Series S版本时遇到困难之后，这位开发者继续进一步解释了自己的立场，并让Sasko为自己帮腔。

paragraphs.en: "I want to ask director Paweł personally," Harada continued. "Honestly, weren't you upset inside because of Series S?"
paragraphs.cn: 「我想亲自问问Paweł总监，」原田继续说道，「说实话，你心里难道没有因为Series S而不高兴吗？」

paragraphs.en: "It constantly throws challenges at us and forces us to optimize our code very cleanly," Sasko responded, appearing to tiptoe around the subject.
paragraphs.cn: 「它不断给我们带来挑战，迫使我们把代码优化得非常干净，」Sasko回应道，似乎在小心翼翼地回避这个话题。

paragraphs.en: "You just used a very polite and elegant way to say 'Xbox Series S sucks,' right?" Harada ploughed on. "Low memory is an issue, but the hardest part is that it's a device so similar to Series X while having awkwardly lower performance. When porting to Switch 2, developers can shift their mindset to 'Switch 2 is a distinct device for Nintendo fans!' But with Xbox, after delivering your absolute best output, it feels like having to do extra work for a slightly weaker child."
paragraphs.cn: 「你刚才只是用一种非常礼貌、优雅的方式说了『XBOX Series S很烂』，对吧？」原田继续说道，「内存低是个问题，但最难办的是，这台设备和Series X如此相似，性能却低得很尴尬。移植到Switch 2时，开发者可以转换心态，认为『Switch 2是为任天堂粉丝打造的独特设备！』但对于XBOX，在你交出了自己绝对最好的成果之后，感觉还得为一个稍弱的孩子做额外的工作。」

paragraphs.en: Gosh. Tell us what you really think, Harada!
paragraphs.cn: 天哪。原田，说说你的真实想法吧！

paragraphs.en: "Furthermore," he continued further, "in markets like the U.S., there are more Series S users than Series X users, so we can't just cut corners. Yet after launch, Series S users direct their complaints at us developers rather than Microsoft, asking 'Why is texture resolution lower only on Series S?'"
paragraphs.cn: 「而且，」他接着说道，「在美国这样的市场，Series S用户比Series X用户更多，所以我们不能敷衍了事。然而游戏推出后，Series S用户会向我们开发者而不是微软抱怨，问『为什么只有Series S上的纹理分辨率更低？』」

paragraphs.en: While Harada's comments will likely not come as a shock to many developers who have been tasked with releasing games across the Xbox Series family this generation, it is rare to hear someone of Harada's prominence discussing the Series S' drawbacks out loud.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管原田的言论可能不会让许多本世代负责在整个XBOX Series系列上发行游戏的开发者感到震惊，但像原田这样知名的人公开讨论Series S的缺点，还是很少见的。

paragraphs.en: In response — and in a continued attempt to not say anything that would get him in trouble — Sasko acknowledged that such Series S drawbacks were real, but that the console also offered a lot of positives. Its more affordable price point meant that developers could get their games played by a wider audience, Sasko offered, while opimtization breakthroughs initially made for Series S had also benefited Cyberpunk 2077 across all platforms.
paragraphs.cn: 作为回应——同时继续努力避免说出任何会给自己惹麻烦的话——Sasko承认Series S的这些缺点确实存在，但这款主机也有许多优点。Sasko表示，其更实惠的价格意味着开发者可以让更多玩家玩到他们的游戏，而最初针对Series S取得的优化突破，也让所有平台上的《赛博朋克2077》受益。

paragraphs.en: Acknowledging Sasko's more positive take, Harada concluded that he was now worried Microsoft would "feel reassured and release a successor like 'Helix S' for the next-gen Xbox as well (laughs)."
paragraphs.cn: 原田认可了Sasko更积极的看法，最后表示，他现在担心微软会「放下心来，在下一代XBOX中也推出一款像『Helix S』这样的后继产品（笑）」。

paragraphs.en: Will Xbox release a lower-powered Helix console? It's unclear. After earlier reports that suggested the new console was reportedly targeting a holiday 2027 launch , more recent estimates have pointed to a 2028 launch for the machine — at an eyewatering $1,200 - $1,800 price point . Maybe that will make Harada reconsider?
paragraphs.cn: XBOX会推出性能较弱的Helix主机吗？目前尚不清楚。此前有报道称，这款新主机据称计划于2027年假日季推出，而近期的估计则指向该主机将在2028年推出，售价高达惊人的1,200至1,800美元。也许这会让原田重新考虑？
